name: Helladius
bio: Helladius is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors dates the poet to the 5th century AD (?).
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 423.

poems.title: Book XI, 423
poems.author: Helladius
poems.text: Dyer who dyes all things and changest them with thy colours, thou hast dyed thy poverty too, and turned out a rich man.
